Agent.Task.Instance.Title: Instance launch check · Read only
Agent.Task.Instance.Prompt: Check whether this Minecraft instance is ready to launch. Prioritize what I should check or adjust, and distinguish confirmed facts from things that still need verification.
Agent.Task.Crash.Title: Crash diagnosis · Read only
Agent.Task.Crash.Prompt: Use these local findings to diagnose the Minecraft crash. Rank the likely causes and suggest reversible checks. If evidence is missing, say what information you need without assuming you saw the raw logs.
Agent.Task.Crash.NoFindings: The local analysis found no shareable diagnostic clues.
Agent.Task.Crash.Runtime: Java {0} · Memory limit {1} MiB · Exit code {2}

Agent.Task.Attached: Task data is only shared with the provider you originally confirmed.
Agent.Task.NotShared: The provider has changed. This data won't be shared. Start a new task from the original screen to share it.
Agent.Task.Busy: Finish or stop the current MofuAgent task first.

Agent.Task.Instance.MetadataReady: The version profile and its inheritance chain are readable.
